items.title: Dining Room Partition
items.description: Created a custom wooden screen partition with built-in decorative shelves, separating the dining area and kitchen while maintaining light flow.

items.title: Staircase TV Wall Unit
items.description: Transformed a bare wall next to the staircase into a high-end entertainment center featuring custom marble cladding, wood slats, and floating cabinets.

items.title: Bespoke Wardrobe & Dressing
